scripts.build:core: cd network-core && (where go >nul 2>nul && go build -o ../bin/dualflow-core.exe ./cmd/dualflow-core || C:\go\bin\go.exe build -o ../bin/dualflow-core.exe ./cmd/dualflow-core)
scripts.test:core: cd network-core && (where go >nul 2>nul && go test -v ./tests || C:\go\bin\go.exe test -v ./tests)
scripts.build: npm run build:core && tsc -b && vite build && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('electron/preload.cjs', 'dist-electron/preload.cjs')"
